title: Credit Builder Accounts Entry Criteria by Plan
content:
Each Credit Builder Accounts plan sets the figures an applicant is measured against: a minimum credit score, a minimum stated monthly income and a required payment account, together with the age, completion and activation figures below.

| Plan | Minimum credit score | Minimum stated monthly income (USD) | Payment account required |
|---|---|---|---|
| Credit Builder 600 Plan | none | 0 (no minimum) | a verified linked checking account |
| Credit Builder 1000 Plan | none | 0 (no minimum) | a verified linked checking account |
| Credit Builder 1200 Plan | none | 800 | a verified linked checking account |
| Credit Builder 1800 Plan | none | 1200 | a verified linked checking account |
| Credit Builder 2400 Plan | none | 1600 | a verified linked checking account |
| Credit Builder 3000 Plan | none | 2000 | a verified linked checking account |

| Figure | Every plan |
|---|---|
| Minimum age at application | 18 years |
| Application validity | 30 calendar days |
| Activation after approval | 1 business day |

## Meaning of each figure

- **Minimum credit score:** the minimum credit score required; "none" means no score is required on any plan.
- **Minimum stated monthly income:** the minimum stated monthly income in USD, where 0 means no minimum.
- **Payment account required:** the payment source required to open the account.
- **Minimum age:** the minimum age at application in years, which is higher where the state's age of majority is higher: Alabama (AL) and Nebraska (NE) 19, Mississippi (MS) 21.
- **Application validity:** the calendar days after the application date within which the application must be completed (the administration fee paid and the certificate funded) before it lapses.
- **Activation:** the business days after approval until the account activates once the administration fee is paid.

## Plan-by-plan income points (hypothetical applicants)

| Applicant's stated monthly income | Plans whose income minimum is met |
|---|---|
| 0.00 | Credit Builder 600 Plan, Credit Builder 1000 Plan |
| 1200.00 | the above, plus the Credit Builder 1200 Plan and the Credit Builder 1800 Plan |
| 1599.99 | the same four; the Credit Builder 2400 Plan needs 1600 |
| 2000.00 | all six plans |
